Rani Mukerji's Mother Krishna Mukerji Dies at 75

Krishna Mukerji, mother of Bollywood actress Rani Mukerji, passed away at the age of 75. The family announced her death and requested privacy. The Free Press Journal noted this event in coverage that also mentioned past statements by Rani Mukerji's mother about her daughter.
